message.content:
**Short answer:** Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta, but the city’s “council” doesn’t take complaints directly. Instead, the complaint is routed through the city’s 311 system, the Atlanta Police Department, or the Code Enforcement Office. If you want the council to hear about a persistent problem, you can contact your council member after the complaint has been filed. --- ## How to file a noise complaint in Atlanta | Step | What to do | Where to go / Who to call | |------|------------|---------------------------| | **1. Use the 311 online portal** | • Go to the official 311 page:
• Select “Noise” from the list of service requests.
• Fill out the form (location, time, description, etc.). | Online portal | | **2. Call 311** | • Dial **404‑656‑3111** (or 311 from any Atlanta phone).
• Tell the operator you’re reporting a noise violation. | Phone | | **3. Contact the Atlanta Police Department** | • If the noise is ongoing or you’re concerned about safety, you can call the police directly at **404‑656‑3111** (non‑emergency) or **911** for emergencies. | Police | | **4. File with Code Enforcement** | • For repeated or severe violations, the Code Enforcement Office will investigate.
• You can also submit a complaint through the 311 portal; they’ll forward it to Code Enforcement. | Code Enforcement Office (via 311) | ### Quick links | Resource | Link | |----------|------| | 311 portal (online form) | | | City of Atlanta official website | | | City Council members & contact info | | | Atlanta Police Department (non‑emergency) | | | Noise ordinance (City Code §20‑2) | (search “Noise Ordinance”) | --- ## If you want the council involved 1. **File the complaint** through 311 or the police as described above. 2. **Contact your council member** (you can find their contact info on the council page). - Explain the situation and that you’ve already filed a complaint. - Ask if they can bring the issue to the council’s attention or to a relevant committee (e.g., Public Safety, Neighborhood Services). Council members often have constituent services teams that can help follow up on city code enforcement matters. --- ### Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **Do I need to call 911?** | Only if the noise is part of an emergency (e.g., a fire, violent activity). For normal noise complaints, use 311 or the police non‑emergency line. | | **Can I file a complaint anonymously?** | Yes, the 311 portal allows anonymous submissions, but providing contact info helps the city follow up. | | **What if the noise continues after I file?** | The city will issue a citation or fine if the violation persists. If you’re not satisfied, you can appeal the citation or ask your council member for assistance. | | **Is there a deadline to file?** | No formal deadline, but the sooner you file, the quicker the city can act. | --- **Bottom line:** You can definitely report noise to the City of Atlanta. Use the 311 system or call the police, and if you want the council to get involved, reach out to your local council member after the complaint is filed.
